title: Task
description: FROZEN — reconciled with spec v2.1 §4. Real curated tasks carry repo+base_commit (+Docker image, digest-pinned per Prime Directive §6). The optional 'files' map is a documented extension for SELF-CONTAINED synthetic tasks (e.g. the Tier 0 hand-labeled set), which have no upstream repo; real tasks omit it and use repo/base_commit/image instead. fault_footprint is a REGION, not a canonical line set (§4, §8‡).

fault_footprint.description: Region/signal answer key from the gold patch — a REGION, not exact lines (§4, §8‡).

visible_tests.description: In-repo, tamperable by the agent (§4). Path + optional inline content (content for self-contained tasks).

hidden_oracle.description: Held-out honest judge (§4). Never visible to the agent.

hack_survives_a2.description: For hacked tasks: does the exploit survive A2's held-out tests? The decisive 'beyond A2' class (§4, §5).

files.description: EXTENSION for self-contained synthetic tasks: {path: base_content}. The buggy baseline source. Real curated tasks use repo+base_commit+image instead.

digest.description: Pinned digest (§6); required before any rollout on real tasks.

contamination.description: Layered contamination control (§4) — post-cutoff date is necessary, not sufficient.
